task: Add a canonical, exact-identity conflict-resolution receipt path for release-unit modify conflicts so true three-way conflicts remain fail-closed but can be resumed after a separately reviewed main resolution without mutating immutable source or child PR state.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The bounded multi-release-unit rehearsal has U01 and U02 closed. After the operation-aware main-overlap fix, U03 now reaches the correct downstream three-way materializer and fails with RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT on tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts. This is a real same-hunk conflict: the immutable source delta is not already present in current main, and automatic source-wins/target-wins resolution remains forbidden. The Control Plane currently has no canonical continuation path for such a legitimate conflict: the workflow aborts with a stack trace, the release-state cannot carry a structured exact conflict identity, and there is no machine-verifiable way for a separately reviewed main resolution to be recognized on replay. The missing capability is therefore a conflict-resolution receipt, not a broader auto-merge engine.
observableOutcomes: A modify three-way conflict returns structured RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT details containing releaseUnitId, file, source parent, source commit, source patch digest, target base SHA, target blob SHA and deterministic resolution-record path.
Successor reevaluation catches the structured materialization conflict and persists it as a normal STALE blocker instead of terminating the workflow before canonical state persistence.
The deterministic resolution-record path is derived from immutable conflict identity and cannot be chosen by the record author.

A main-merged resolution record is accepted only if its contract, releaseUnitId, file, source parent/commit, patch digest and resolution base are exact and the current target blob/file mode equal the record's resolved blob/mode.
A valid resolution record is consulted only after ordinary three-way application fails; it cannot bypass a cleanly applicable source patch.
When a valid record proves the current-main blob is the reviewed resolution, materialization preserves that blob and records the modify operation as already applied via conflict resolution.
Missing, stale, forged or mismatched resolution records remain fail-closed.
No source-wins, target-wins, conflict-marker, fuzzy patch or manual child-PR mutation path is introduced.
The capability exposes enough exact metadata to create a separate Plan/CI/Truth-governed U03 resolution PR after this generic fix merges.
unresolvedRisks: A resolution record could become a bypass if it is accepted without exact source patch identity.
A later main edit of the resolved file could make an old record stale while still leaving the record present.
A record authored against a non-ancestor resolution base must not be accepted.
The runtime must not consult a resolution record before proving ordinary three-way application actually conflicts.
A structured blocker that is thrown rather than returned could still prevent release-state persistence.
The resolved blob may preserve syntax while violating semantic source intent; final authority therefore remains the separately reviewed resolution PR plus normal CI/Truth, not the receipt alone.
A resolution record must not authorize writes outside the single declared modify file.

in: Derive source patch digest from the immutable source parent→source commit exact per-file patch.
On three-way modify conflict, look up only the deterministic resolution record in the exact target-base tree.
Accept a resolution only when target-base ancestry and current target blob/file mode match the exact record.
Return resolution metadata in alreadyApplied materialization evidence.
Change scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs successor materialization error handling so structured release-unit materialization errors become canonical BLOCK/STALE results with exact details.
Add behavioral regressions for no-record conflict, valid resolution receipt, forged blob, stale/non-ancestor base and unchanged clean three-way behavior.
out: No LLM or heuristic merge inside the trusted runtime.
No fuzzy patch application, conflict-marker commit or partial materialization.
No manual edit of U03 child PR or control-plane release-state.
No change to create/delete/rename/regenerate materialization semantics.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This capability creates the only allowed escape hatch from an intentional fail-closed source-vs-main conflict. A weak receipt could become arbitrary code-substitution authority, so every accepted resolution must be cryptographically and historically bound to the immutable source delta and exact main state.

acceptanceCriteria: The deterministic resolution key/path depends on releaseUnitId, file, sourceCommit, sourceParent and sourcePatchDigest.
RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT exposes that exact identity plus targetBaseSha and targetBlobSha.
A missing record preserves RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT and creates no materialized commit.

A valid record requires contract shoporation.release-unit-conflict-resolution.v1, exact identity fields, non-empty resolutionPlanTaskId, a resolutionBaseSha that is an ancestor of targetBaseSha, and resolvedBlobSha/fileMode equal to the exact file currently present at targetBaseSha.
A valid record is considered only after git apply --3way --index failed for the immutable source patch.
A valid record causes the target blob to be preserved and the operation to appear in alreadyApplied evidence with resolution metadata; no file content is taken from the record.
A forged patch digest, source commit, source parent, file, blob, file mode or non-ancestor resolution base is rejected with an explicit RELEASE_UNIT_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_INVALID blocker.
Successor reevaluation catches structured materialization errors and returns decision=BLOCK/code/details so prepareActiveUnit can persist STALE canonical release-state.
Existing clean three-way merge, current-main preservation, create semantics and conflict fail-closed regressions remain PASS.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
After generic merge, replay immutable source to obtain the exact U03 resolution identity, then resolve U03 only through a separate governed main PR plus receipt and replay again.
invariants: Immutable source commit and source patch remain the authority for what conflict is being resolved.
The resolution receipt never supplies executable file content; it only attests that the exact current-main blob is the approved resolution.
Only one deterministic receipt path exists for a given exact conflict identity.
A receipt cannot authorize a different file, source delta or target blob.
Ordinary clean three-way application wins over any receipt; receipt is fallback-only.
No thrown conflict may bypass canonical STALE state persistence.
Resolution approval occurs through normal main Plan/CI/Truth governance, not mutable PR metadata.

failureModes: Conflict still escapes as an uncaught workflow exception and release-state is not persisted.
Receipt lookup path can be influenced independently of conflict identity.
Receipt with a different patch digest or source commit is accepted.
Receipt points to a resolved blob different from current target-base file.
Receipt resolutionBaseSha is unrelated to current main history.
Receipt is used even though three-way patch would apply cleanly.
Valid receipt marks operation applied but materialization accidentally stages or commits the conflicting file anyway.
edgeCases: resolutionBaseSha equals an older valid ancestor
clean three-way apply with stale record present
multiple later main commits after a valid resolution while file blob remains unchanged
later main edit changes resolved file blob while old record remains

alternatives.summary: Keep three-way conflict fail-closed, persist exact conflict identity, and allow replay only after a separately governed main resolution is bound by a deterministic exact receipt.
alternatives.reason: Preserves immutable-source authority and normal code-review/CI governance without teaching the trusted runtime to invent semantic merge resolutions.

alternatives.summary: On conflict, overwrite target with source content.
alternatives.reason: PR #1089 already proved this can delete hundreds of lines of later main evolution.

alternatives.summary: Ignore the source hunk on conflict and keep target content.
alternatives.reason: Would silently drop immutable release-unit intent.

alternatives.summary: Use heuristic/fuzzy/AST conflict resolution inside the trusted executor.
alternatives.reason: Would create an uncontrolled semantic code-authoring authority inside release infrastructure.

alternatives.summary: Edit the U03 child branch until it passes.
alternatives.reason: Breaks deterministic materialization and resumable proof.

specialistReviews.finding: A conflict-resolution mechanism can easily become a hidden general merge engine.
specialistReviews.resolution: The runtime never computes resolution content. It only validates a separately governed current-main blob against an exact deterministic receipt after genuine three-way failure.

specialistReviews.finding: A receipt must not become arbitrary blob-substitution authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind it to source parent, source commit, exact patch digest, release unit, file, ancestor resolution base and exact current-main blob/file mode; the record contains no executable content.

specialistReviews.finding: Current U03 conflict is real and source intent is not already present in main.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve fail-closed conflict until a reviewed main resolution exists; then use exact blob equality to recognize the resolved state without rewriting it.

specialistReviews.finding: U01 and U02 are closed; U03 is final child and now blocked by legitimate modify conflict after operation-aware overlap correctly allowed downstream proof.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add canonical conflict handoff/receipt, then resolve U03 in a separate main PR and replay immutable source.

specialistReviews.finding: Previous plans modeled fail-closed conflict detection but not resumable continuation after a legitimate conflict.
specialistReviews.resolution: Promote structured conflict identity and governed resolution receipt into permanent regression coverage.

challenge.scenario: Three-way apply succeeds and a stale resolution record also exists.
challenge.finding: Receipt must not override normal source patch semantics.
challenge.resolution: Consult resolution only after actual three-way failure.

challenge.finding: Current behavior aborts workflow before a reusable exact handoff exists.
challenge.resolution: Throw/return structured conflict code and persist STALE with deterministic receipt path.

challenge.scenario: Receipt matches file but references another source patch.
challenge.finding: Could launder unrelated code as conflict resolution.
challenge.resolution: Exact source parent/commit/patch digest are mandatory.

challenge.scenario: Receipt resolved blob differs from target-base blob.
challenge.finding: Main changed after approval or record is forged.

challenge.scenario: Resolution base is not an ancestor of current target base.
Main advances after valid resolution without touching resolved file.
challenge.finding: Exact target-base SHA equality would make a durable resolution unnecessarily stale.
challenge.resolution: Allow descendant target bases only while current file blob/mode still equal receipt.

challenge.finding: Old approval no longer proves current content.
challenge.resolution: Blob/mode mismatch invalidates receipt and requires a new exact resolution.

challenge.scenario: Conflict occurs after another operation was staged in temp index.
challenge.finding: No partial child commit may survive.
challenge.resolution: Existing transactional temp-index/worktree semantics remain; resolution lookup changes only the conflicted operation result.

challenge.scenario: Structured materialization conflict is thrown inside successor reevaluation.
challenge.finding: Workflow currently terminates before parent state can persist blocker details.
challenge.resolution: Catch release-unit materialization errors and return BLOCK/code/details through prepareActiveUnit.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Implement deterministic resolution identity/path and exact record validation in scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs.
Catch structured successor materialization errors in scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs and preserve code/details through canonical STALE state.

Extend tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts with real temporary Git repositories proving no-record conflict, valid receipt, record tamper/staleness, clean-patch precedence and structured blocker propagation.
Merge only after exact PR-head SUCCESS and green main CI.
Replay immutable source to obtain the exact U03 conflict identity from the new structured blocker.

Create a separate Plan/CI/Truth-governed main resolution PR containing only the conflict-resolved current-main file plus its exact resolution receipt, merge it, replay immutable source, and require U03 child proof/merge plus parent closure.

requirements.requirement: A real release-unit modify conflict must remain fail-closed yet resumable only through a separately governed exact current-main resolution bound to the immutable source delta by a deterministic machine-verifiable receipt.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The trusted runtime may not invent source-wins, target-wins, fuzzy or AST merge resolutions.
A receipt with mismatched source patch identity, main ancestry or resolved blob may not be accepted.
A structured release-unit materialization conflict may not abort before canonical STALE blocker persistence.

notes: Live evidence: immutable rehearsal source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65; U01 and U02 already closed. After PR #1092 operation-aware trusted main overlap merged, replay attempt 9 / Release Unit Execution #217 advanced beyond RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT and reached the intended downstream materializer, which failed with RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT on tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts.
